spec.description:
Collect hardware health and performance metrics as well as sustainability KPIs of your hosts with MetricsHub®; visualize the gathered telemetry data in the comprehensive Hardware Host (MetricsHub) dashboard.
MetricsHubs collects metrics from servers (Cisco, Dell, HPE, Huawei, IBM Lenovo, SuperMicro, etc.), storage systems (NetApp, Dell EMC, Hitachi, HPE, IBM, Pure, Huawei, etc.), network devices (Cisco, Aruba, Dell, HP, F5, Juniper, Oracle) and other equipment like PDUs, UPS from APC, Raritan, Eaton, etc.

The overall power consumption reported for the host during the last year.

If less than 365 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.
spec.title: Yearly

spec.description:
The overall energy cost reported for the host in the past year.

If less than 365 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.
spec.title: Yearly

spec.description:
The overall CO₂ emitted by the host during the past year.

If less than 365 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.
spec.title: Yearly

spec.description: The host's current power consumption.
spec.title: Power

spec.description: The host's current power usage multiplied by the site's PUE.
spec.title: Power * P.U.E

spec.description: The current estimated internal temperature of the host.
spec.title: Ambient

spec.description: The reading of the host's temperature sensors (when available).
spec.title: Temperatures

spec.description:
The number of degrees Celsius (°C) remaining before the temperature reaches the closest warning temperature threshold of the host.

A value of 0 indicates a critical temperature.
spec.title: Heating Margin

spec.description: Today's energy cost for the host.
spec.title: Cost

spec.description:
The overall CO₂ emitted by the host during the last 24 hours.

If less than 24 hours of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.
spec.title: Daily

spec.description: The host's power consumption displayed as a graph.
spec.title: Power Consumption

spec.description:
The type of power consumption reading:
- Measured, if the value is reported by the manufacturer's agent
- Estimated, if the value is estimated by Hardware Sentry based on the discovered devices and their current usage.
spec.title: Power Consumption

spec.description:
Data transmitted and received by the host.

Positive values correspond to transmitted data.
Negative values correspond to received data.
spec.title: Total Traffic (bytes/s)

spec.description: The reading of the host's fans speed (when available).
spec.title: Fans Speed

spec.description: The network interfaces and their current link status (plugged or unplugged).
spec.title: Network Links

spec.description:
The network interfaces bandwidth utilization.

The bandwidth utilization should stay under 90% at all times.
spec.title: Bandwidth Utilization

spec.expr:
sum(hw_errors_total{site="$site", host_name="$host_name", hw_type="network"})
/ 
(sum(hw_network_packets_total{site="$site", host_name="$host_name", direction="receive"})
+ sum(hw_network_packets_total{site="$site", host_name="$host_name", direction="transmit"}) * 100)

spec.description:
The highest network interface error ratio (total traffic vs errors).

This value should be at 0% or as close to 0% as possible.
spec.title: Max Error Ratio

spec.description: The total disk size of the host (when available).
spec.title: Disk Size

spec.description: The average speed of all the host's fans.
spec.title: Avg Fan Speed

spec.description: Time since the monitoring of this host by Hardware Sentry was started.
spec.title: Collect Started

spec.description:
The disks remaining lifetime in percentage.

A value lower than 3% indicates that the disk should be replaced.
spec.title: Endurance Remaining

spec.description: The breakdown of the host's energy consumption per components.
spec.title: Power per Device Type

spec.description: The reading of the host's voltage sensors (when available).
spec.title: Voltages

spec.description: The percentage of battery charge (when available).
spec.title: Battery Charge

spec.description: The total memory size of the host (when available).
spec.title: Memory

spec.description: The maximum speed of the host's CPU (when available).
spec.title: CPU Max Speed

spec.description: The total number of discovered devices and sensors per type.
spec.title: Monitored Devices

spec.description: The number of detected errors per hour and component type (when available).
spec.title: Errors per Hour

spec.description: The vendor and model information of the host (when available).
spec.title: Vendor and Model

spec.description:
The overall power consumption reported for the host in last 24 hours.

If less than 24 hours of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.

spec.expr: label_join(hw_status{site=~"$site", host_name=~"$host_name", state="ok"} > 0 or hw_status{site=~"$site", host_name=~"$host_name",  state="degraded"} > 0 or hw_status{site=~"$site", host_name=~"$host_name", state="failed"} > 0, "device_id", "_", "hw_type", "id")
